name: Year-end bank transfers -> cut-off and double-counting risk
rationale: Transfers in transit at year-end can be double-counted or omitted, and may be used to window-dress liquidity. The rule directs cut-off testing that matches both sides of every material transfer to bank value dates and reperforms the in-transit position.
